description: This file defines a handler class for managing device notifications within an Android application. It includes interfaces, singleton implementations, and the core NotificationsHandler class which processes JSON requests to retrieve notification snapshots or perform actions like open, dismiss, or reply on notifications.

classes.name: NotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: An interface that defines methods to retrieve notification snapshots, request service rebinds, and execute notification actions.

classes.name: SystemNotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: A singleton object implementing NotificationsStateProvider, providing default system notification handling.

classes.name: NotificationsHandler
classes.description: The primary class handling notification-related JSON requests, managing notification states, and executing notification actions.

methods.name: handleNotificationsList
methods.description: Handles JSON requests to retrieve the current notification snapshot and returns it as a JSON string wrapped in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleNotificationsActions
methods.description: Processes JSON requests to perform actions on notifications like open, dismiss, or reply and returns the result.

methods.name: readSnapshotWithRebind
methods.description: Reads the current notification snapshot and requests service rebind if necessary.

methods.name: snapshotPayloadJson
methods.description: Serializes a DeviceNotificationSnapshot into a JSON string.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Extracts a trimmed string value from a JsonObject by key, returning null if not present or empty.

methods.name: forTesting
methods.description: Factory method to create a test instance of NotificationsHandler with a custom state provider.
